name: Vapos, LLC.
old_description: Organic pasteurization and sterilization / Validated log reduction
about:
Vapos, LLC is headquartered in Jamestown, Rhode Island, and operates two processing facilities: a plant in Linden, New Jersey, and the H2O Express facility in Newman, California. The company specializes in organic pasteurization and sterilization services for the food industry.

Its core offering is contract pasteurization using two primary technologies: the proprietary H2O Express steam pasteurization system and dry-heat treatment, both designed to achieve validated log reductions at low temperatures. The company reports more than 50 validated commodities, covering nuts and seeds such as almonds, cashews, hazelnuts, macadamias, peanuts, pecans, pistachios, walnuts, and sesame and chia seeds; grains and flours including corn flour, regular flour, and treated corn flour; as well as spices, dried fruits, and pet foods.

Vapos serves food manufacturers, spice manufacturers, pet food manufacturers, and nut and grain processors. Its customer base includes participants in the almond, pistachio, and peanut supply chains, and the company regularly exhibits at events such as the ASTA Annual Meeting, the American Pistachio Growers Conference, and The Almond Conference.

The company emphasizes food safety as its mission and holds FSSC 22000 certification through SAI Global, positioning its validated processes as a way for brands to protect product integrity and meet regulatory requirements.

name: Vasoptic Medical Inc.
old_description: We specialize in the development and deployment of advanced blood flow imagers and perfusion monitoring systems.
about:
Vasoptic Medical Inc. operates from Columbia, Maryland, where it develops and deploys advanced blood flow imagers and perfusion monitoring systems. The company's founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

The company's core products are noninvasive optical imaging systems that capture blood flow dynamics at video rates without the need for contrast agents. These imagers are designed for clinical diagnostics and research applications, providing perfusion data that complements existing angiography methods such as OCT-angiography, fluorescein angiography, and ICG angiography.

Vasoptic's systems serve clinical settings, particularly in ophthalmology, where they assist in diagnosing vascular conditions, as well as research institutions studying blood flow dynamics. The technology generated notable interest at the ARVO 2026 Annual Meeting in Denver, indicating engagement with the vision research community.

The company emphasizes that its video-rate, contrast-free imaging offers a distinct advantage over traditional angiography by revealing real-time blood flow fluctuations over each cardiac cycle, enabling assessments that static imaging cannot provide.

name: Vegas Vogue Woodworks
old_description: Premium materials. Precision design. Unmatched craftsmanship.
about:
Vegas Vogue Woodworks operates from a workshop in North Las Vegas, Nevada. The studio was founded by Mert, who believes design starts with how a room should feel. The company focuses on custom furniture and architectural millwork for high-end residential and commercial clients.

The workshop handles design, 3D modeling, CNC fabrication, hand finishing, and installation under one roof. They produce bespoke kitchens, walk-in closets, feature walls, offices, built-ins, and one-of-a-kind furniture pieces. All work is built in-house, from private estates in Laguna Beach and Newport Beach to commercial projects like a restaurant on Fremont Street in Las Vegas.

Clients include homeowners in exclusive neighborhoods across Las Vegas, Los Angeles, and Orange County, as well as commercial clients seeking millwork that withstands heavy use. The studio serves both residential and commercial interior markets.

The company differentiates itself through a single-team model: every project is approved via a 3D model before cutting, fabricated with CNC precision, finished by hand with bookmatched veneers and hand-rubbed finishes, and installed by their own crew. This end-to-end control ensures consistency from private homes to the Vegas Strip.

name: Vent Fab
old_description: We provide excellent service in specialty and custom fabrication from start to finish by meeting with our customer on site
about:
Vent Fab operates from Woodbury, Minnesota. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It began as a custom duct fabrication shop focused on serving HVAC contractors with on-site consultation and rapid turnaround.

The shop specializes in high-volume sheet metal fabrication, welding, and custom duct manufacturing. Its capabilities include spiral duct and fittings, coil line duct production using patented coil loading and auto corner insertion equipment, and certified TIG and MIG welding. The facility handles orders ranging from small change-outs to 10,000-pound duct runs.

Vent Fab serves the HVAC, commercial kitchen, medical facility, clean room, marine, and industrial process sectors. Its customers include mechanical contractors, field foremen, and project managers who rely on the company for duct revisions, tenant improvements, and full HVAC system installations.

The company positions itself as an extension of the customer's operation, emphasizing upfront specification verification, triple-check quality control, honored pricing, and on-time delivery to the exact job-site location.

name: Venture Home
old_description: We put solar panels, battery storage, and EV charging together in one system, tailored to your lifestyle.
about:
Venture Home, headquartered in Hudson, Massachusetts, has been designing and installing whole-home solar energy systems since 2014. The company operates across the Northeast with fully in-house design, installation, and service teams, employing hundreds of dedicated staff.

The firm integrates solar panels, battery storage, EV chargers, smart electrical panels, and microinverters into unified systems managed through a mobile app. To date, it has installed more than 15,000 systems for residential customers, handling everything from initial design and permitting to final commissioning and ongoing maintenance.

Venture Home serves homeowners in Connecticut, New Hampshire, New Jersey, New York, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, and Rhode Island. Its customers are typically residential property owners seeking to reduce electricity costs, gain backup power during outages, and manage energy consumption through smart controls.

The company differentiates itself with a no-pressure sales approach, a 25-year workmanship warranty, and certifications including Tesla Certified Installer, Enphase Gold Installer, and NABCEP credentials. Its all-in-one model aims to provide predictable energy costs and automatic energy management without relying on utility grids.

name: Vermont Green Printing
about:
Vermont Green Printing, operating as VG Printing, is a contract screen-printing and embroidery shop based in Morrisville, Vermont. The business was launched in 2014 by co-owner John Goodhue, who had spent more than three decades producing tie-dyed and screen-printed apparel for concert tours such as the Grateful Dead, Phish, and the HORDE festival, as well as wholesale accounts in the U.S. and Japan. Goodhue’s first commercial sales date back to 1983 at a Tucson street fair, and his move to Vermont marked a shift from touring merchandise to a local, service-oriented operation.

The company provides custom screen printing using water-based and algae-based inks, embroidery on caps, jackets, and fleece, full-color garment printing with a 24-piece minimum, and promotional product sourcing. Its printing process avoids plastisol and solvents, relying instead on discharge and opaque water-based inks that are free of PVC, phthalates, and heavy metals. In 2022 the shop adopted Algae Black ink, a bio-based pigment. The facility on Old Creamery Road handles both small and large runs, though specific headcount and floor space are not disclosed.

VG Printing serves a mix of regional and national clients. References on its site include Vermont Festivals LLC, the gaming brand Gamers Nexus, Riverbend Market, Green Mountain Community Fitness, the rowing-machine manufacturer Concept2, Paul’s Hardware, and the tech retailer Level One Techs. Orders range from event merchandise and corporate apparel to e-commerce fulfillment for online stores.

The company states that its founding purpose was to minimize environmental impact, pay living wages, and create products customers can feel good about. It donates at least 1% of gross sales each month to organizations such as the Vermont Food Bank, Planned Parenthood of Northern New England, The Ocean Cleanup, the Last Prisoner Project, and the Equal Justice Initiative. Goodhue’s own history — including a year in prison for cannabis cultivation — informs the shop’s support for criminal-justice reform.

about:
Vermont Teddy Bear Factory operates from Shelburne, Vermont. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed in the provided sources. The business began as a maker of custom teddy bears and stuffed animals, with a focus on assembly in Vermont using components sourced internationally.

The company produces a wide range of plush toys, including teddy bears in sizes from 13 inches to 6 feet, as well as specialty animals such as cows, unicorns, dinosaurs, and seasonal characters. Products are assembled in Vermont from parts made abroad, and the facility also operates a "Bear Hospital" that provides free lifetime repairs for any purchased plush. No details on facility size, headcount, or annual volume are available.

Vermont Teddy Bear Factory sells directly to consumers through its e-commerce website, offering gifts for occasions such as holidays, birthdays, and awareness campaigns (e.g., breast cancer awareness). The company does not list specific B2B industries or wholesale customers in the provided material.

The brand emphasizes a lifetime guarantee and free repairs as a core differentiator, positioning its products as heirloom-quality keepsakes. The "Assembled in Vermont" label and the Bear Hospital service are highlighted as reasons customers choose the company.
